title: Wonderful Mc
description: Wonderful MC is a Public Minecraft SMP featuring a unique Token System where players receive random powerful tokens (like Warden, Breeze, etc.) by spinning a wheel every 1 hour of playtime. Tokens can be upgraded to max level.
body:
### ✨ Wonderful MC – Public Token SMP (CUSTOM MADE PLUGIN )

Welcome to **Wonderful MC**, a unique Public Minecraft SMP where survival meets powerful abilities!

💎 **Features:**
- 🎁 Get **Random Tokens** by spinning the wheel after every **1 hour of playtime**
- ⚡ Tokens include powers like **Warden, Breeze, and more**
- 🔼 Upgrade your tokens to **maximum level** and become stronger
- ❤️ **4 Life System** – each death by another player reduces 1 life
- ☠️ Lose all lives and face serious consequences
- 🤝 Active community, smooth gameplay, and balanced mechanics

🎯 **How it works:**
- Join the server and start playing
- After 1 hour, spin the wheel to get a random token
- Use and upgrade your token to gain powerful abilities
- Survive PvP and protect your lives

🌍 Build, fight, and rise to power in **Wonderful MC**

👉 Join now and become the strongest!
